content.value: The maximum magnetization $\mathbf { M } _ { \mathsf { s a t } }$ in iron is about $1 . 7 5 \times 1 0 ^ { 6 } ~ \mathrm { A m } ^ { - 1 }$ . This corresponds to all possible net spins aligning parallel to each other. Calculate the effective number of Bohr magnetrons per atom that would give $\mathbf { M } _ { \mathsf { s a t } } ,$ given that the density and relative atomic mass of iron are 7.86 gcm-³ and 55.85, respectively.
